product: Offline Mock for Documented Microsoft Graph Read Endpoints

accompanying_terms.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot APIs preview stop-sign note
section_references: Section 3(b)(18) — autonomous Copilot APIs remain disabled

customer_agreement_override.precedence_note: Customer tenant agreements vary; must be reviewed separately before any live tenant opt-in.

policy_review.rationale: Offline mock shape only. Live Microsoft Graph dispatch remains disabled until fresh terms-body digest verification, customer written privacy statement, and tested off-switch drill pass Phase 0/3 gates.
change_triggers: Microsoft API Terms of Use digest change
Microsoft Graph v1.0 schema or permission model change
Tenant Conditional Access or admin-consent policy change

required_product_licenses: Customer-owned separately licensed Microsoft 365 subscription for any future opted-in tenant test (none used by offline mock)

metered_costs.summary: Offline mock has zero cost; any future live Graph metered endpoints must be quoted before activation.

customer_data_use.purpose: Read-only retrieval of explicitly scoped SharePoint/OneDrive files and Planner tasks during delegated human-agent collaboration.
customer_data_use.scope: Only items reachable under the signed-in user's delegated ACLs within declared XENIA data zones.
customer_data_use.term: Bounded to the active Work run; no secondary training or advertising use.
customer_data_use.evidence_requirement: Recorded customer data-use permission with explicit scope and expiry before live enablement.
customer_data_use.withdrawal_path: Revoke delegated OAuth grant in Entra ID and activate local runtime brake immediately.

data_lifecycle.source_acls: Preserve source Microsoft IDs, ETags, sensitivity labels, and ACL references.
data_lifecycle.destination_acls: Restrict stored run artifacts to matching XENIA data_zone audience; never copy confidential items into literals.
data_lifecycle.correction: Append correction.appended event; source tenant items remain authoritative.
data_lifecycle.restriction: Stop reads immediately upon grant revocation or brake activation.
data_lifecycle.retention: Ephemeral local cache only in mock mode; tenant retention remains controlled by customer tenant.
data_lifecycle.export: Versioned JSON run records with explicit omissions for uncopied external artifacts.
data_lifecycle.deletion: Delete local mock cache on run closure; tenant-side deletion is out of scope for read-only adapter.
data_lifecycle.abandonment: Uncompleted runs stop at declared limits without retrying.
data_lifecycle.uninstall: Disable adapter manifest, revoke Entra delegated grant, and remove local adapter configuration.
data_lifecycle.account_closure: Revoke broker credential references and purge local adapter state; report upstream tenant retention separately.

read.summary: Fetch documented driveItem metadata, ETag, and webUrl against offline mock fixtures.
List delegated Planner tasks against offline mock fixtures.

authorization_requirements.provider_grant: Delegated Entra OAuth grant scoped strictly to Files.Read and Tasks.Read (disabled in mock mode).
authorization_requirements.customer_data_permission: Separate customer-granted data-use record binding purpose, scope, retention, and withdrawal path.
authorization_requirements.runtime_policy: PolicyHost brake lowered and current manifest digest pinned before any live call.
authorization_requirements.exact_execution_approval: Explicit execution.approved event bound to proposal_digest before any effectful action (none enabled here).

execution_rules.idempotency_rule: Deterministic fixture replay; no second local dispatch after execution.started is recorded.
execution_rules.compensation_rule: Read-only mock performs no external mutations; ambiguous outcomes stop for observation.

governance.audit_readiness: Draft only; live tenant audit readiness must be verified separately prior to Phase 3 exit.
governance.uninstall_path: Remove adapter entry from runtime policy and revoke delegated Entra app grant.

non_endorsement_notice: XENIA is an independent open-source framework for human-agent work. Planned optional adapters are designed to interoperate with separately licensed Microsoft services through published interfaces. XENIA is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Microsoft.
not_established: This manifest is an offline development draft and does NOT authorize live Microsoft Graph dispatch.
Placeholder SHA-256 digests do NOT represent a fresh HTTP terms capture or legal review.
Schema validity does not prove Entra consent, tenant policy compliance, license entitlement, or Microsoft endorsement.
